$description: The translucency axis. Solid is the baseline and the fallback: the frosted values are applied additively inside an @supports (backdrop-filter) block, so an engine without backdrop-filter gets the solid values with no separate rule and no lower-specificity rule for the on-state to defeat. prefers-reduced-transparency forces them back (A11Y-12). Only chrome surfaces frost — the sidebar, the header, the dialog scrim; content surfaces stay solid so a clipboard preview is never read through anything.

solid.$description: Default, and what [data-translucency="off"] or an engine without backdrop-filter gets.

frosted.$description: Applied only under [data-translucency="on"] AND @supports backdrop-filter. On macOS this is what makes the window read as a native panel; on Android it is a quiet blur behind the header.
